title: Per-body toroidal-residual J₂ classification row
description: One body's classification on the Chandrasekhar 1969 rotating-fluid equilibrium-figure sequence. Single row_type catalogue (`toroidal_residual_classification`); each row pairs measured gravitational quadrupole J₂ with the dimensionless rotation parameter q = ω²R³/(GM), the moment-of-inertia factor C/MR², and a regime classification (sphere / maclaurin / jacobi / bar / ring). The fossil_figure flag marks bodies whose observed J₂ exceeds current-rotation equilibrium prediction (Mercury, Luna).

name.description: Body name (lower-case, matches BODIES roster: terra / mars / venus / mercury / luna / jupiter / saturn / uranus / neptune / io / europa / ganymede / callisto / titan).

row_type.description: Single value in this catalogue. Field retained for symmetry with multi-row-type planetary catalogues.

rotation_period_days.description: Sidereal rotation period in days, positive magnitude. For retrograde rotators (Venus), the magnitude is what matters for figure equilibrium.

equatorial_radius_km.description: Equatorial radius R in kilometres. For gas giants this is the 1-bar level.

rotation_parameter_q.description: Dimensionless rotation parameter q = ω²R³/(GM). Below 0.187 → Maclaurin sequence; above → Jacobi triaxial; above 0.27 → bar instability; above 0.36 → Roche fission.

J2_observed.description: Measured gravitational quadrupole coefficient J₂. Dimensionless; positive by convention (oblate).

moment_of_inertia_factor.description: Normalised moment of inertia I_M = C/(MR²). 2/5 = 0.4 for uniform density; smaller values indicate central density concentration (gas giants).

regime.description: Chandrasekhar-sequence regime classification derived from q. Computed by `_classify_regime(q)` in the hand-coded module.

fossil_figure.description: True if observed J₂ exceeds current-rotation equilibrium prediction by more than a small factor — meaning the body's shape was set by historical rotation, not present rotation. True for Mercury (3:2-lock fossil) and Luna (frozen at faster rotation).

notes.description: Per-row free-text notes — historical context, fossil-figure rationale, cross-references.

source_doi.description: DOI of the cited gravity-field reference.

source_published_date.description: ISO 8601 partial date for the cited source.

entered_locally_at.description: ISO 8601 date when this row was added to the AMSC catalogue.

source_version.description: Optional. For gravity-model release tags (e.g., 'EGM2008', 'GRAIL primary mission').
